description: This source file defines the class '_ENTERPRISE_BlockedUserList' which manages a list of blocked users, either loaded from a list or a file, and includes methods for pre-call hooks to block API calls from users flagged as blocked. It integrates with caching, database, and logging components, and performs user validation before processing API requests.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_BlockedUserList
classes.description: A class that manages a list of blocked users, supports loading from list or file, and provides an asynchronous pre-call hook to deny API access to blocked users based on the list or database flags.
